text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The year-end showdown approaches. Having 
won the Kikuka Sho, Super Creek steps up 
to announce herself as a new rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Under the pressure of the decisive battle, 
Tamamo Cross's appetite begins to dull 
once more. Though it is proof she has 
entered battle mode, it is still a 
concern...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If her appetite keeps declining like this, 
she won't be able to beat Oguri Cap. After 
searching for another way to gain an edge—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Retiring from the Twinkle Series within 
the year. In exchange, she resolved to 
train with every ounce of strength she 
had. A battle where everything was on the 
line had begun.
